_README: HAND-EDITABLE. One entry per trading day, keyed by date. Read by the coach layer of REPLAY DESK.

briefing, lesson, lesson_text, events and scenarios are shown BEFORE the session, so they must be written as of that morning: no outcomes, no settle prices for that day, no hindsight ('fell to', 'rallied to', 'settled'). A unit test enforces this.
driver_summary and driver_keywords are used ONLY in the guided debrief after the session (keywords auto-mark whether your answer named the driver). Never shown before or during a session.
Briefing text and lessons were supplied by the desk owner. Events, scenarios and driver summaries were written at build time from the real items in headlines.json.

events[].consensus: what the market expected for a scheduled print, known before the print. The coach's view scores prints against it ('not recorded' = no figure was available at build time; add one if you have it).

2026-10-27.briefing: Settles Mon: WTI 101.76, Brent 115.81, near last week's highs. Weekend: first high-level Tehran meeting (Iran, Saudi, Pakistan, Turkey). No barrels restored by any headline so far. API after the close.
2026-10-27.lesson: TRADE THE SURPRISE, NOT THE HEADLINE
2026-10-27.lesson_text: What matters is what is already in the price.

events.label: API weekly bulletin (after the pit close)

scenarios.name: Diplomacy gets paid
scenarios.tape: Lower highs, bounces sold under VWAP, Brent leading the way down.

scenarios.name: Talk, no barrels
scenarios.tape: An early dip gets bought, price reclaims VWAP and stays inside Monday's range.

scenarios.name: Risk returns
scenarios.tape: A fast spike that is still above the prior high three bars later.

2026-10-27.driver_summary: Renewed diplomacy drove the day: Iran's leadership discussing conditions to end the war pushed crude lower for a second session. The Saudi interception report involved no damage to energy infrastructure and did not reverse the move. API came after the close.

2026-10-28.briefing: Unconfirmed Houthi claim of a Ras Tanura strike overnight, no Saudi confirmation. EIA 09:30 CT (poll: crude +0.5M, distillates -0.9M; API showed crude -2.03M). Fed decision 13:00 CT, hold expected, the dissent count is the tell.
2026-10-28.lesson_text: Price the claim at a discount until someone verifies it.

events.label: EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report
events.consensus: poll: crude +0.5M, distillates -0.9M; API showed crude -2.03M

events.label: Fed rate decision
events.consensus: hold expected; the dissent count is the tell

scenarios.name: Claim confirmed
scenarios.tape: The overnight gap holds, pullbacks stay shallow, Brent leads.

scenarios.name: Claim fades
scenarios.tape: The overnight premium bleeds back toward VWAP before the EIA.

scenarios.name: The prints decide
scenarios.if: neither side of the claim is resolved
scenarios.tape: Direction comes from the EIA versus the poll, then the Fed. Judge each first move after three bars.

2026-10-28.driver_summary: An unconfirmed Houthi claim on Ras Tanura put a bid under crude overnight, and the 09:30 EIA showed a 1.892M crude draw against a poll looking for a small build. The Fed held with only two hawkish dissents, fewer than feared.

2026-10-29.briefing: Reports overnight that VP Vance wrote to Tehran's security chief about reviving talks knocked about 1% off crude in Asia. GDP and PCE at 07:30 CT. Gas storage 09:30 CT.
2026-10-29.lesson_text: If price falls through a bullish headline, the headline was already paid for.

scenarios.name: Diplomacy builds
scenarios.tape: Lower highs, rallies fail at VWAP.

scenarios.name: Diplomacy denied
scenarios.if: a pushback or denial of the letter
scenarios.tape: Shorts cover and price takes back the Asia drop.

scenarios.name: Macro in charge
scenarios.tape: Dollar up, crude heavy whatever the Gulf headlines say.

2026-10-29.driver_summary: Diplomacy hopes faded crude: reports that VP Vance wrote to Tehran's security chief outweighed a fresh tanker attack in the Strait. Hot GDP and PCE lifted hike odds and the dollar. Trump's midday pushback on the letter reports was the counter-headline.

2026-10-30.briefing: Yesterday's fade met a VERIFIED limpet-mine attack on a Hormuz tanker. December Brent expires today. ECI at 07:30 CT. OPEC+ meets Sunday.
2026-10-30.lesson_text: Unconfirmed claims get discounted; verified attacks re-anchor the premium.

scenarios.name: Confirmed risk repriced
scenarios.if: the verified attack stays the story
scenarios.tape: Buyers defend dips, higher lows above VWAP.

scenarios.name: Sell the news
scenarios.if: no new highs in the first hour
scenarios.tape: Longs take profit and price drifts back to VWAP.

scenarios.name: Weekend squaring
scenarios.tape: The range compresses in the afternoon as positions are cut into the weekend.

2026-10-30.driver_summary: A verified limpet-mine attack on a Hormuz tanker re-anchored the premium to confirmed shipping risk after days of unconfirmed claims. Steady flows, December Brent expiry and the ECI print were secondary.

2026-11-02.briefing: Weekend: Qatar-mediated draft proposal headlines knocked crude about 4% pre-open. OPEC+ held December steady Sunday, no new barrels. Hormuz still effectively closed; distillate cracks near $90.
2026-11-02.lesson: PREMIUM UNWIND IS NOT PHYSICAL LOOSENING
2026-11-02.lesson_text: Watch the cracks; they tell you whether barrels actually moved.

events.label: No scheduled data in the session

scenarios.name: Unwind extends
scenarios.tape: The gap down holds, bounces fail under VWAP, and cracks soften too.

scenarios.name: Gap fill
scenarios.tape: The pre-open drop is bought and price works back toward Friday's range.

scenarios.name: Flat price only
scenarios.if: crude sells but products do not
scenarios.tape: Crude trends lower while cracks hold. That is premium coming out, not barrels arriving.

2026-11-02.driver_summary: A diplomacy unwind: weekend reports of a Qatar-mediated draft to reopen Hormuz hit crude at the open and the selling kept going, with no deal signed. OPEC+ changed no barrels. Distillate cracks held near $90, so products did not confirm a physical loosening.

2026-11-03.briefing: Election day. Monday was a 7% washout on diplomacy headlines with no deal signed. EIA tomorrow.
2026-11-03.lesson_text: Whipsaw days hurt both sides; the correct position is often smaller or none.

events.label: US midterm elections (results after the close)
API weekly bulletin (after the pit close)

scenarios.name: Two-way chop
scenarios.tape: Breaks fail in both directions and price keeps crossing VWAP.

scenarios.name: Continuation
scenarios.tape: Price stays under Monday's low for three bars or more.

scenarios.name: Retrace
scenarios.tape: Higher lows, VWAP reclaimed, cracks widening.

2026-11-03.driver_summary: A whipsaw day with no decisive driver: signs of abundance in Mideast grades on one side, a rebound off the low as cracks widened on the other. Deal probability was rising but no barrel had moved, and election day kept conviction low.

2026-11-04.briefing: Election results are repricing the war premium politically. EIA 09:30 CT after four straight crude draws; distillates near multi-year lows. JPMorgan says October already ran a surplus.
2026-11-04.lesson_text: On regime days, politics and positioning outrank inventories; a bullish print can be sold.

scenarios.name: Politics outranks barrels
scenarios.tape: Selling persists and any bounce on the EIA fails within three bars.

scenarios.name: Inventories reassert
scenarios.tape: Price holds above its pre-print level and reclaims VWAP.

scenarios.name: Exhaustion
scenarios.if: the early flush finds no new sellers
scenarios.tape: A base forms with higher lows into the afternoon.

2026-11-04.driver_summary: Political repricing: the election results cut the war premium across the board. Crude fell through a bullish EIA (a fifth straight crude draw, distillates under 100M for the first time since 2003), and JPMorgan's surplus note reinforced the move.

2026-11-05.briefing: Crude is down about 12% on the week, deal odds cut to about 10%, more ship attacks reported, Brent has traded under $100. Gas storage 09:30 CT.
2026-11-05.lesson: OVERSOLD IS A CONDITION, NOT A SIGNAL
2026-11-05.lesson_text: Bounces after washouts are short-covering until a real catalyst confirms them.

scenarios.name: Short-covering bounce
scenarios.tape: A grind higher on light pullbacks that stalls at yesterday's breakdown levels.

scenarios.name: Bounce fails
scenarios.tape: An early pop is sold back under VWAP and the lows are retested.

scenarios.name: Real catalyst
scenarios.tape: A spike that holds, with Brent back above $100.

2026-11-05.driver_summary: A short-covering reversal: prediction markets cut the odds of a negotiated settlement to about 10% after a 12% weekly collapse, and more ship attacks were reported in the Gulf. There was no new physical catalyst.

2026-11-06.briefing: Jobs report 07:30 CT. Brent spiked through $100 overnight on attack reports. Spec length is near record lows. COT after the close.
2026-11-06.lesson_text: The first move on a headline is the most expensive one; make the market prove it can hold the level.

events.label: CFTC Commitments of Traders (after the pit close)

scenarios.name: Spike holds
scenarios.tape: Brent stays above $100 after the jobs data and dips to the level are bought.

scenarios.name: Spike fades
scenarios.tape: Brent cannot hold $100 through the first hour; lower highs back toward yesterday's range.

scenarios.name: Macro cap
scenarios.tape: Dollar up, crude pinned in a range.

2026-11-06.driver_summary: An overnight Brent spike through $100 on tanker-attack reports faded through the session. A strong jobs report lifted the dollar and hike odds, and the market priced de-escalation rather than the attacks, with spec length near record lows.

2026-11-09.briefing: Weekend: a tanker was hit exiting Hormuz, no Sunday transits reported, Qatar's PM goes to the White House today. Unverified reports will fly. CPI and the EIA outlook land Tuesday.
2026-11-09.lesson: TWO SOURCES OR IT IS A RUMOR
2026-11-09.lesson_text: On unverified deal reports, the spread and the second hour tell the truth.

events.label: Qatar's PM at the White House (time not announced)
CPI and the EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook

scenarios.name: Deal hopes
scenarios.if: the White House meeting produces progress
scenarios.tape: Brent sells harder than WTI, the spread narrows, bounces fail.

scenarios.name: Attack premium
scenarios.if: the weekend tanker hit stays the story
scenarios.tape: The opening bid holds and the Brent-WTI spread widens.

scenarios.name: Rumor whipsaw
scenarios.if: unverified reports with no second source
scenarios.tape: Spikes both ways that reverse inside the hour. The second hour sets the direction.

2026-11-09.driver_summary: Deal headlines drove it: the report of Qatar's PM carrying an Iranian interim proposal, the unconfirmed Israel Hayom report of an $8bn offer, and Trump saying new strikes were highly unlikely. Brent fell harder than WTI and the spread narrowed sharply. Natural gas decoupled higher on LNG feedgas and cold.
